extracted.intended_audience: postgraduate research students and early career researchers interested in learning about peer review training/certification
extracted.subtask_description: Information and guidance about Elsevier's Certified Peer Reviewer online course: who it's for, how it's delivered, what is required for certification, and what benefits certification provides for researchers seeking reviewer roles or CV evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles and practice of refereeing
rubrics_metrics.description: The course will introduce you to the principles and practice of refereeing which is a key part of the scholarly publication process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed as foundational knowledge for peer reviewers; presented as necessary background to participate effectively in the scholarly publication process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content developed with input from senior academic editors
rubrics_metrics.description: The course has been developed by Elsevier, with input from senior academic editors on leading journals in order to give insights into many different aspects of the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies course content aligns with real editorial standards and offers editor-informed perspectives and practical insights into peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended audience / suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: The course has been specifically designed to give those who have not yet reviewed – or who feel they would like additional training in this area – a greater understanding of the process in order to boost participation in the academic peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted at novices and early-career reviewers; positions itself as remedial/introductory training to increase reviewer participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery format and assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: The content is delivered via directed self-learning in the form of recorded webinars, podcasts and an online multiple choice online test, so that you can follow the course in your own time, and schedule your learning around your other commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes flexible, self-paced multimodal learning; includes an online multiple-choice test as an assessment element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification requirements (core and optional modules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Several core modules must be completed to gain certification, but you can “pick and choose” additional elements to suit your individual learning needs and interests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certification is contingent on completing mandatory core modules; optional modules allow customization of learning path.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benefits of certification (evidence and career advantage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Becoming a certified peer reviewer can help evidence your expertise and enthusiasm for the process and may aid you in your ambition to be added to journal reviewer pools. It will also be a useful addition to your academic CV, evidencing scholarly publication related skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions certification as verifiable proof of reviewer-related skills that may increase chances of being invited to review and strengthen academic CVs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access requirement: Researcher Academy profile
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need to set up a Researcher Academy profile in order to access the materials and start learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative prerequisite: create an account/profile on Elsevier's Researcher Academy to enroll and access course content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context within broader training portfolio
rubrics_metrics.description: This course is just one element of Elsevier's Researcher Academy. Many more freely accessible e-learning resources are available through the Academy to support researchers through the research cycle, encompassing preparation, writing, publication, peer review and communication of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages learners to view the course as part of a wider set of resources across the research lifecycle and to browse the full portfolio online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative and complementary certification schemes
rubrics_metrics.description: Several other online and certification schemes are available to you, covering legal research skills, conducting systematic reviews and building IP knowledge and skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes there are other certification options relevant to research skills beyond peer-review training; suggests consulting the Building and Evidencing your Research Skills LibGuide for details.
